# Velaire Heating & Air

> Velaire is a fictional, WebMCP-native Chicago HVAC service demonstration. Agents can search the site, inspect sourced market context, prepare a project plan, check fit, negotiate, and compare changed work while visible human controls retain commitments. Browser-local tool health is observable without logging inputs or outputs.

When this page is open in a supporting agent browser, it automatically registers the tools for that page. The user does not install, connect, or assign a separate WebMCP chatbot; they ask their existing browser agent in the same chat.

## Primary routes

- [HVAC service website](https://velaire-hvac.vercel.app/): Registers 29 customer WebMCP tools and presents services, price bands, service area, evidence, and the human-approval policy.
- [Customer service room](https://velaire-hvac.vercel.app/demo/customer?judge=1): Registers the same 29 customer tools beside the visible request, route plan, negotiation, booking, receipt, and change-order interface.
- [Owner desk](https://velaire-hvac.vercel.app/demo/owner): Registers 19 tools: 13 shared foundation/operations tools and 6 private owner tools. Sending remains a human action.
- [Agent operations](https://velaire-hvac.vercel.app/demo/operations): Registers 13 foundation/operations tools beside the BLS/FRED chart, 3–10 day timeline/Kanban, and live call-health ledger.
- [Public source](https://github.com/syedahmad0786/velaire-hvac): Implementation, architecture, tests, and demonstration instructions.

## Shared foundation and operations tools

- `velaire_get_site_manifest`, `velaire_search_site`, `velaire_list_services`, and `velaire_get_service_details`: Discover canonical website and service information.
- `velaire_check_service_area`, `velaire_get_policies`, `velaire_get_contact_options`, and `velaire_get_agent_help`: Resolve normal website intents with explicit safety and authority boundaries.
- `velaire_get_market_price_context` and `velaire_compare_quote_context`: Return exact BLS/FRED chart values while separating a national nonresidential index from fictional local price bands.
- `velaire_prepare_project_plan` and `velaire_get_project_plan`: Prepare/read a revision-checked 3–10 day planning draft; never promise dates, crews, equipment, or inspections.
- `velaire_get_webmcp_health`: Read privacy-safe browser-local tool result codes and handler latency.

## Customer agreement tools

- `velaire_check_service_fit`: Read-only service, postcode, urgency, budget, prerequisite, price-band, and emergency-fit check.
- `velaire_get_business_evidence`: Read-only canonical pricing, credentials, availability, cancellation, warranty, and synthetic-review cards.
- `velaire_estimate_service_range`: Read-only transparent planning range based only on the fictional Velaire rate card; never a quote or market benchmark.
- `velaire_get_project_preflight`: Read-only project checklist plus freshness-dated official permit, rebate, utility, and federal source routes; never an eligibility decision.
- `velaire_open_service_case`: Open a bounded request. It does not book, charge, diagnose equipment, or collect direct contact details.
- `velaire_get_service_case`: Read the current case revision, sent terms, pending human decision, and valid next actions.
- `velaire_set_service_location`: Store bounded customer-supplied location text only with explicit confirmation; never geocode it.
- `velaire_get_case_visuals`: Return the structured event graph, canonical visual URL, totals, and map-search links.
- `velaire_plan_service_route`: Return direct Google/Apple driving links and a synthetic postcode planning band; never claim live traffic, GPS, or an arrival promise.
- `velaire_wait_for_owner_reply`: Wait in rounds of up to 15 seconds for a newer human-sent owner event; timeout and cancellation do not mutate state.
- `velaire_submit_case_message`: Send a revision-checked question or counteroffer.
- `velaire_compare_offer_versions`: Deterministically compare two sent offers without changing the case.
- `velaire_prepare_booking`: Stage the latest unexpired offer for visible human confirmation; it cannot confirm or charge.
- `velaire_get_booking_receipt`: Read the complete immutable accepted-term snapshot.
- `velaire_compare_change_order`: Compare later price, scope, and timing against the accepted snapshot.
- `velaire_audit_invoice_against_receipt`: Trace invoice lines to the accepted offer or human-approved change orders and flag unresolved charges without disputing or paying them.

## Owner tools

- `velaire_list_service_cases` and `velaire_get_owner_case`: Read the owner queue and authoritative case.
- `velaire_stage_owner_reply`, `velaire_stage_service_offer`, and `velaire_stage_change_order`: Create private drafts only. A visible human must send each draft.
- `velaire_wait_for_customer_reply`: Wait in rounds of up to 15 seconds for a newer customer event without mutating the case.

## Trust and safety

All businesses, people, reviews, credentials, prices, bookings, and records are fictional. Evidence cards declare that they are synthetic and not independently verified. Review content is marked untrusted. Gas-smell, smoke, sparking, fire, and carbon-monoxide phrases stop the ordinary service workflow. The demo neither diagnoses equipment nor takes payment, books a real appointment, or collects direct contact details. A user may provide a synthetic location with explicit confirmation for map links; it is not geocoded or verified.

## Intended agent behavior

Use the registered WebMCP tools instead of scraping visible text. Read the current case revision before any write. Never claim a staged owner draft was sent. Never claim a prepared booking was confirmed. Ask the human to use the visible confirmation control when `humanActionRequired` is true.
